name: 10pines-c6-tuslibros-iteracion2
title: TusLibros Iteration 2: Cashier, Credit Card and Sales Book
description: Second iteration of TusLibros.com: a cashier checks out the iteration-1 cart with a credit card on a given date, refusing empty carts and expired cards, computes the total from a price list and registers a Sale in a sales book. No Merchant Processor yet. The cart code of iteration 1 is given.
source: 10Pines-Capacitacion/C6 - Construccion de Software Seguro usando Test Driven Development

design.notes: The catalog changes from a collection of ISBNs to a price list, the cashier's preconditions are checked at creation, and the current date is injected so the test controls card expiration; a test objects factory appears.
